'''Dragon Slayer''' is the fifth primary [[Quests|quest]] and the first of the main story in ''RuneScape: Dragonwilds''. This is where the [[Player Character|player]] is introduced into the first major narrative arc of [[Ashenfall]], also known as Kuldra's Saga, and their legend begins.

==Overview==
{{Quest details
|desc = Recruited with promises of glory, your first challenge is to defeat General Velgar.
|start = Speak to the [[Wise Old Man]] in [[Bramblemead Valley|Bramblemead Village]].
|req = [[First Steps]]
|item_req =
*1 [[antlers]]
*23 [[ash log]]s
*1 [[coarse animal fur]]
*1 [[dragon tooth]] ([[iron pickaxe]] needed to gather)
*1 [[bloodwood sap]] ([[iron logging axe]] needed to gather)
*5 [[bronze bar]]
|rec =
* Good [[armour]] and [[weapon]]s.
* [[Food]]
* [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] [[weapon]] to kill the [[deer]]
* [[Antipoison potion]]s
|enemies =
* Multiple [[Goblin (race)#Goblin enemies|goblin]]s and [[Garou (race)|garou]]
* Multiple [[giant rat]]s and [[putrid rat]]s
* Multiple [[vault guardians]]
* [[Velgar]]
|qtype = primary
}}

==Walkthrough==
{{Map|Dragon Slayer|float=right|center=136814,73201}}
===Part I: To Slay Dragons!===
To start this quest, speak to the [[Wise Old Man]] in [[Bramblemead Valley|Bramblemead Village]] and he will instruct you on getting started with hunting down [[General Velgar]]. Before you can start hunting dragons, you need a shelter. He will tell you to build a little shelter, with at least a [[bed roll]] in it, which you have to claim. To be able to claim it, you need to build at least a foundation, 3 walls, and a ceiling, and place the bed roll in it. Once you finish your task, talk with him again.

He will tell you that one of the adventurers, young [[Cathan]] is missing and needs to be found. To do this, he will cast a locator spell, but he needs some [[antlers]] for that. Hunt down [[deer]]s in the valley and bring the antlers to him. As they tend to run away, you need a [[ranged]] or [[magic]] weapon to kill them.

The spell will point you to a nearby castle within the valley, so this will be your next destination.

===Part II: A Lost Adventurer...===
When you arrive at the [[Keep of Blue Flames]], it will look eerily similar to Lumbridge Castle, but with Bandosian banners flying. This place will have a ''lot'' of goblins, so pack some [[food]]. You will find Cathan's Journal lying at the top of the castle next to a loot chest. Read his journal and you will learn that you need to go to the [[Whispering Swamp]] to locate a "blue-flame door". At this point, [[Velgar]] will descend to the keep, spraying poison next to the gate, then attack with his poison puddles. You can either wait for his attack to end or just run out of the keep, dodging the strikes.

Journey through the "blue-flame door" (the [[dragonkin vault]] [[Vertentis Kara]]) and speak to Spitfoot at the end of the vault. He will detail Cathan's journey, his betrayal, and his desire to go to [[Ghornfell]]. Take this information back to the [[Wise Old Man]] in the Bramblemead Valley, and he will remark about Cathan's foolish recklessness. After telling you that if he is willing to brave the [[Garou (race)|Garou]], Cathan must have a way to deal with Velgar, he will ask you to dive into [[Ghornfell]] to pick up his trail.

Once you arrive in the [[Fractured Plains]] (an area of Ghornfell), you will then be prompted to go check out [[Velgar's Rise]], a monumental tower at the heart of the region, for any information on Cathan's whereabouts.

===Part III: The Beginnings of a Legend...===
When you arrive at the Rise, you will encounter [[Cathan]]'s ghost. Speak to him and he will talk about how he was so sure he could defeat Velgar (after remarking how death sucked). He will tell you that the [[Garou (race)|Garou]] mobbed him and dragged him to the tower, holding him down in front of Velgar as they sacrificed him. He will then give you a recipe to make a [[challenge horn]] that can challenge Velgar in his tower.

You need to travel to both [[Bloodblight Swamp]] and [[Stormtouched Highlands]] to gather the materials for the horn.
* In the Highlands you have to travel past the skeleton which the [[Garou (race)|Garou]] use as home on the western part and you can find a dragon skull. You can mine it's [[Dragon's Tooth|teeth]] with an [[iron pickaxe]] to get the [[dragon tooth]].
* In the swamp, you have to travel to the castle on the most southern point. In the castle you can find the [[bloodwood tree]] (and some [[Garou (race)|Garou]]), and you can harvest it with [[iron logging axe]] to gather the [[bloodwood sap]].
Combine them with 5 [[bronze bar]] and you can create the horn.

===Part IV: Fight for your life===
When you have the horn, grab your best armour and weapon, bring some [[antipoison]] potions and [[food]], and enter [[Velgar's Rise]]. The top of the tower is basically a triangle, with a pedestal at the centre. When you place the horn on the [[dragonkin altar]], Velgar will arrive on one corner.

He will use poison spray and poison puddle bombs or stomp both his legs, which will create spikes in your direction. If you get close to using melee, he will stomp one leg, which is closer to you, and also bite forward and hit sideways with his head. All of his attacks are delayed, so you can prepare and dodge, and between each attack he will wait a bit.

After he loses 1/4 of his health, he will fly away and use his poison puddle bomb attack multiple times. After that, he will land on another corner, the next of the previous one, clockwise. In the second phase, he will use multiple attacks one after another, before he waits a bit. The attacks are the same as in the previous phase.

After his health is brought to half, he will again fly away, and his signature attack will happen again. He will land again on another edge, still next to the previous one, clockwise, and the fight continues like before. He will once more fly away when he loses 3/4 of his health. He will land on the original edge, where he can be attacked again.

Once Velgar is defeated, you will get his [[Velgar's Head|head]]. Go outside of the tower, speak to the [[Wise Old Man]] (who has replaced Cathan's ghost), and give him the head to complete this quest.

'''Congratulations! Quest complete!'''

==Rewards==
* [[Tome of Construction - Vol 1.]] (After being asked to get antlers)
* [[Dragon Slayer reward pack]]s, 
** After following Cathan into Ghornfell - containing 3 [[clay]], 3 [[redberries]], and 3 [[harralander]].
** End of quest - containing a [[Tome of the Dragon Slayer]], a [[noxious draconic visage]], and an [[anti-dragon shield]].

== Trivia ==
* The name of the quest is inspired by ''[[rsw:RuneScape|RuneScape's]]'' own, and the ''{{OSL|Old School RuneScape|Old School RuneScape's}}'' variant quest, that shares the same name.
** Just like the quest, you are asked to fight a dragon named Velgar, whose name is an anagram for [[rsw:Elvarg|Elvarg]].
** Just like the same quest, you return to the quest giver with the head of the dragon you have slain.
*In the Alpha Test, before public release, this was the only primary quest to complete.
*For those who participated in the closed Alpha Test, completing this quest (among other challenges) awarded the testers with a [[Dragonbane Cape|special cape.]]

}}'''First Steps''' is a primary [[quest]] that teaches you the basics of the game before introducing you to the narrative. It is recommended for first-time players to ''not'' skip through these quests and jump into [[Dragon Slayer]] so that they can fully understand the mechanics of the game.

==Walkthrough==
===Begin your adventure!===
[[File:Wise_Old_Man.png|thumb|150px|Wise Old Man in the Temple]]
Go and speak to the [[Wise Old Man]] in the temple. He will tell you about the dragon and offer to teach you about the basics, which you can either accept or refuse. If you refuse it, you can talk with him again in [[Bramblemead Valley|Bramblemead Village]] to finish the quest. If you accept the tutorial, he will send you to [[Doric]] just outside the temple, starting [[Getting Started]].

=== Before Setting Off... ===
''This step is covered, in more detail, through the following quest articles: [[Getting Started]], [[Ratcatcher]], and [[Rune Mysteries]].''

Doric will teach you how to make processing stations, introduce to you the building system, and then send you off to Vannaka. The slayer master will send you to fight off nearby rats, teach you how to cook your food, and help you know which way the pointy end goes before sending you to Zanik. When you talk to Zanik, she will help you learn the magic system, crafting runes for spells, and even unlock a spell or two. When she has taught you everything, she'll then send you off to the Wise Old Man.

===Finishing up...===
After completing the above section, or if you skipped the tutorial, go to [[Bramblemead Valley|Bramblemead Village]] and find the Wise Old Man on the first floor of a ruined building at the far end of the village. Talk to him to learn about the next step in your adventure.

''Congratulations. Quest complete!''

'''Granite Mauled''' is a secondary [[Quests|quest]] where players help [[Doric]] find valuable relics within [[Ashien's Watch]].

==Overview==
{{Map|Granite Mauled|width=350px|height=350px|center=85000,135000|zoom=3|float=right}}
{{Quest details
|desc = Uncover the secrets of Ashien's Watch.
|start = Speak to [[Doric]] north-east of [[Fractured Plains]].
|req = [[First Steps]]
|item_req =

* 5 or more [[air rune]]s to cast [[Windstep]] or [[ash logs]] to cross the bridge

|qtype = secondary

==Walkthrough==
===Starting off===
The quest can be started by talking to Doric north-east of [[Fractured Plains]]. Doric is located south of Ashien's Watch on a lookout with ruins on it. There's a broken bridge leading over to the other side as well. He will tell you that ''Ashien's Watch'' was where all the "valuable relics and supplies" were located during the time of the dragon, and he was looking for it. But he was chased away — and now he wants your help.

===Skeklac Kara===
Once you have located and activated all four statues in Ashien's Watch, enter the [[Skeklac Kara]] [[Dragonkin Vault|vault]]. Make sure to bring forms of antipoison (cooked [[food]] with poison resistance or some [[weak antipoison potion]]s), as there are [[putrid rat]]s and poisonous gas bubbles that explode and [[poison]] you. Make sure to check for blind spots, as the gas bubbles are in many corners and can deal high damage to the player. Upon reaching the lever that opens the [[vault corruptor]]'s doors, the corruptor can deal high damage and poison in addition to putrid rats in the area. It is recommended to use [[ranged weapons]] or [[magic]] to avoid getting hit.

After defeating the boss at the end, interact with the statue, and you will receive a blueprint. Bring the blueprint back to Doric for translation.

Quest Completed!

==Rewards==
* Recipe for [[granite maul]] (66-95 damage, 4 Combo - Special: Battering Ram)
* [[Imbued granite maul head]] - placed in the player's quest items section of the inventory

You will need to craft these for the granite maul:

'''Goblin Diplomacy''' is a secondary [[Quests|quest]] that can be started by talking to [[Zanik]] on the ridge in [[Bramblemead Valley]] overlooking the [[Whispering Swamp]], or by finding one of the two Bandosian amulets.

==Overview==
{{Map|Goblin Diplomacy|height=350px|width=350px|center=160000,80000|zoom=3|float=right}}
{{Quest details
|desc = Zanik needs you to stop a prophecy before it's too late.
|start = Speak to [[Zanik]] on the ridge in [[Bramblemead Valley]].
|req = [[Rune Mysteries]]
|item_req =
* A [[Logging Axes|logging axe]] and 20 [[Woodcutting]] (if searching the guild reliquary)
* One [[steak]] (if bribing a caged goblin for the reliquary location)
|rec =
* Good [[armour]] and [[weapon]]s (ranged or magic when fighting the [[garou druid]])
* [[Weak Antipoison Potion|Anti-poison potion]]s
* [[Air rune]]s to cast [[Windstep]]
* [[Food]] and [[water]]
* 32 [[stone]], 20 [[rune essence]], and 1 [[vault core]] to build a [[lodestone]] to Zanik
|enemies =
* Multiple [[Goblin (race)#Goblin enemies|Goblin]]s
* [[Garou druid]]
|qtype = secondary
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Starting off===
Zanik will tell the player they sense the presence of a prophecy in the [[Outlook Ruins]] to the north-east of her, as well as in the [[Adventurer's Guild]] to the south. Both areas are overrun with goblins, so make sure you're properly equipped to take on the challenge with health potions, food, and water.

'''It is recommended that you place a lodestone at Zanik's location, as you'll have to come back to Zanik to complete the quest. This way, you can easily fast travel back to the location.'''

===Bandosian Amulets===
You can choose to either search the nearby ruins first or the Adventurer's Guild first. Both contain a [[reliquary]] containing the Bandosian amulet, but only one can be looted. The amulet in the location you didn't check first ends up stolen by a garou druid.

The ruins' reliquary is tucked away in a corner, whereas the guild reliquary is blocked by thorny vines, requiring 20 [[Woodcutting]] to cut down. The guild is also more dangerous due to the number of goblins inhabiting it, so it's recommended to obtain the amulet from the ruins' reliquary. Both locations have a caged goblin outside. [[Bilegut]] can be found outside the Outlook Ruins, and [[Wormelbow]] can be found outside the Adventurer's Guild. When talking to either of them before obtaining a Bandosian amulet, they'll offer to tell you the exact location of the respective reliquary in exchange for a [[steak]]. This is optional, as the reliquaries can be found without their help.

Next, you'll need to head to whichever location you '''did not''' obtain the Bandosian amulet from. If you obtained the amulet from the ruins, then head to the guild, and if you obtained the amulet from the guild, then head to the ruins. You don't need to defeat all the goblins there—simply locate the caged goblin and eliminate the goblins around it. Once the area is clear, speak with the caged goblin to learn the whereabouts of the second Bandosian amulet. The goblin will reveal that a garou-beastman has taken the second amulet to a cave in the Whispering Swamp.

[[File:Goblin Diplomacy - Lower swamp access point.png|thumb|Location of the bridge to reach the lower area of the swamp]]

Now, you must head to the [[Druid's Cave|cave]] in the swamp where a [[garou druid]] is keeping the second [[Druid's Bandosian Amulet|Bandosian amulet]]. However, the journey is not quite straightforward. '''The cave is located at the very bottom of the swamp''', so be sure you go down into the swamp safely first, and then search for the cave. Otherwise, you will be running above the cave location and won’t be able to find the entrance. Once you've located the cave entrance, enter to find the garou druid. Defeat the garou druid to obtain the second Bandosian amulet. The garou druid is quite strong and can inflict a potent poison. To defeat it more easily, use magic attacks at a distance, and be sure to dodge its poison thorns.

===Returning to Zanik===
After obtaining both Bandosian amulets, return to Zanik. She will thank you for bringing the two amulets, and this will complete the quest. As a reward, Zanik will give you the [[goblin war banner]].

==Overview==
{{Quest details
|desc = Explore the RuneCrafting{{sic|supposed to be Runecrafting?}} Guild to discover the means to craft a powerful magical weapon.
|start = Interact with the statue of a wizard in the [[Runecrafting Guild]] in [[Bramblemead Valley]].

==Location==
{{Map|Highlighting the Problem|height=350px|width=350px|center=145931,22320|zoom=4}}

==Walkthrough==
The statue requires a password. The password is found in the [[Thishepen Kara]] [[Dragonkin Vault|vault]], found at the base of the cliff near the guild, in a room which requires [[Windstep]] to reach. You do not need to complete the whole vault; you can simply go for the password, which is found at a glowing blue statue hidden on an elevated path to your right in a room of four giant rats. The password is '''pthentorok'''.

Upon returning to the statue and giving it the password, a [[mysterious voice]] will talk to the player and give them a [[mysterious orb (uncharged)]]. The player must then interact with three [[Orb Stand|pedestals]] on the three towers surrounding the main tower in the guild. The player must use [[Windstep]] to reach the top of the towers, and can take advantage of surrounding rubble and other scenery.

After interacting with the three pedestals, the orb turns into the [[mysterious orb (charged)]], and the player must return to the first statue, which will then give the player the recipe for the [[staff of light]], finishing the quest.

'''Heartstrings''' is a secondary [[Quests|quest]] that follows the story of an unnamed elf, leaving behind numerous stones spread across the area as they grieve their late human partner, [[Meya]]. 

==Overview==
{{Quest details
|desc = Sing the bard's song of rememberance{{sic|misspelled remembrance}}.
|start = Interact with the memorial stone at the top of the hill at [[Fractured Plains]].
|req = [[Getting Started]]

==Walkthrough==
You can start this quest by interacting with a glowing blue memorial stone found next to a unique, large tree with blue leaves found in the [[Fractured Plains]] region. The tree is on top of where the first Fractured Plains dungeon is located.  You can get to the top by casting the [[Windstep]] spell a few times up the rocks to the right of the cave where you access that dungeon. Upon searching the first memorial stone, players will receive a [[crystal seed]] in their quest [[inventory]].

===Memorial Stone Locations===
[[File:Heartstrings - Tree Locations (Map).png|thumb|A screenshot of the overworld map showcasing the locations for all Memorial Stones needed to progress the quest; they must be interacted with in order, 1 as the first and 7 as the last.|center|width=546x546]]

There are a total of 7 memorial stones to be found, all in an eastward direction from the first. All quest progression points are therefore next to the unique trees with memorial stones found next to them. From the first tree, proceed eastward to find the next tree. As these trees are located in the open area of the Fractured Plains, it is recommended to be ready for combat with several [[wolf|wolves]] and [[Garou (race)|garou]] that you will encounter during the quest.

Reaching the final tree and singing the song will complete the quest.

==Walkthrough==
{{Map|Dog Days|width=350px|height=350px|center=83000,0|zoom=2|float=right}}
===Investigate the Garou and their rituals===
Talk to Vannaka, who is standing under a cliff in the eastern part of the Highlands (see the image). He will tell you about the garou and ask you to investigate their rituals.

Go to the location of the lore book, beneath the wyrm corpse, and read it. It is advised to go around and approach from the north, as there are fewer enemies. There is a [[garou thane]] next to the book, but facing the opposite direction, so you can sneak there and read the book.

===Challenging the King===
After you read the book, you have to defeat the [[Garou King]] and get his [[Tainted King's Token|tainted token]]. Go to the castle in the north-west of the Highlands. Use [[Windstep]] as much as you can, to avoid as many enemies as you can.
At the top of the hill, in the castle, you need to defeat the king, who is a thane, and his attacks are the same. It is suggested to cast Windstep onto the arches of the Garou King's ruined temple to safespot its attacks.

===Ritual of Purification===
Go back to Vannaka after you get the token. He will tell you that the token is tainted and needs to be purified. ==Walkthrough==

===Part I: The omnious side...===
To begin this quest, speak with the [[Wise Old Man]] near [[Ashien's Watch]]. He will explain that he had been studying a mysterious door with some sort of strange necromantic runes on it, and tells you the password to get past the door.

Use '''option 1''' after speaking to the Wise Old Man, to open the door, and you will arrive at the [[Forgotten Temple]]. As there is already a lodestone here, you will not need to spend your own materials to make a lodestone. Step up the steps and head into the temple to speak to [[Death (Grim Reaper)|Death]], who will inform you about [[Imaru]] and the overall situation in [[Fellhollow]]. You will then follow out the right side (your right) towards a place where you can speak to [[Postie Pete]] about entering Fellhollow, but before you do, Death will say one more thing. This will, inevitably, introduce you to his store, where you can buy (using [[soul fragment]]s) exclusive rare items that cannot be acquired through [[vestige]]s and normal gameplay.

'''Note:''' ''There will be a small intro cutscene that plays when you first enter Fellhollow.''

===Part II: Fraying the soul to rift...===
Next, speak to Postie Pete. He will then explain that, in order to get into Fellhollow, you must cross a river of [[wither water]]. As you cross through the water, you will build up [[Wither]] and feel your soul rift. Just before crossing fully, you will enter the [[soul rift]] state and be able to use the nearby [[spectral door]]. Enter this door, and you will arrive in one of the regions that make up Fellhollow: [[Bleakfields Valley]]. As soon as you arrive, you must quickly find a [[Purifying Pool|fountain]] (marked on your compass with visible blue beacons) to purify your soul, for [[Imaru]] will have sensed your arrival into her domain. The longer you are in this state, the more danger you are in, as the tormented souls (human, wolves, etc) will start to appear at growing power levels.

''For this instance of arrival, quickly follow the path, and you will reach one such fountain. You will have to hit the spectral tangles until they disappear to be able to purify your soul.''

Once you arrive in this place, seek out [[Cathan]]. He will be nearby on a cliff, floating next to three stone tablets with strange markings.

'''Note:''' After arriving in Fellhollow for the first time (aka accessing the temple and soul-rifting through the spectral door), you will be granted permanent access to Fellhollow in ''all'' worlds.

===Part III: Disrupting the seal===
Speak to Cathan to uncover what else to do next, which is to gather curse fragments. There are only three you need to collect:
* [[Curse fragment (grief)]]
* [[Curse fragment (rage)]]
* [[Curse fragment (despair)]]

Once you have acquired all three curse fragments, you will then be able to gain access to [[Imaru's Tower]] in the centre of [[Hope's Fall]].
====[[Curse fragment (grief)]] - [[Emberwood]]==== 
To get this fragment, you will need to interact with four pillars that are nearby to dispel a divine barrier. You will need to find the corresponding [[shrine]]s (which can be activated in any order) to dispel it.

Once all of the altars are activated, the barrier will be dispelled, allowing you to enter Emberwood Village and obtain the [[curse fragment (grief)]].

'''Note:''' ''If you start a fresh world, regardless of how far you have done the quest or fully completed it, you will need to re-activate all of the statues to dispel the barrier.''
=====[[Shrine to Guthix]]=====
* Guthix altar: Defeat a [[green dragon]] (can be safespotted with [[ranged]] attacks, must be at least 150m away to avoid the dragon attacking) and interact with it. It will be within a druid circle to the west.
'''Note:''' The Guthix altar will not allow interaction until the green dragon has been defeated.
=====[[Shrine to Saradomin]]=====
* Saradomin altar: A bit north-east, you will find it atop a lone rock within a small lake. You will need to repair this altar first by finding the [[Saradomin symbol]] down below (in the water) and interact with it again.
=====[[Shrine to Armadyl]]=====
* Armadyl altar: A bit east of where you defeated the [[green dragon]], on a small island in the river, there are three ghosts who have committed a grave injustice. You must find the perpetrator and solve the crime in order to activate this altar.
** Choose the following options:
** '''3''' - There was a mass murder.
** '''2''' - Because they thought it was funny.
** '''3''' - The snickering ghost
** '''3''' - They found it too funny. Matching the motive. (The option about the weather also works)
=====[[Shrine to Zamorak]]=====
* Zamorak altar: You will need to enter a nearby temple through the roof and jump into the temple to interact with the altar. There is a lever nearby to open the gate to the temple so you can leave freely.

====[[Curse fragment (rage)]] - [[Lake of Lost Souls]]==== 
To obtain this fragment, you must venture into the [[Vekchenven Kara]] vault that is underneath a waterfall. You will need to defeat a [[zogre]] at the end of the dungeon in order to access this shard. Once you defeat the zogre, you will then be free to obtain the [[curse fragment (rage)]].

====[[Curse fragment (despair)]] - [[Silverthorn Keep]]==== 
To obtain this fragment, you will need to venture into the keep itself. There will be many [[rotsworn zombie]]s, [[skeletal archer]]s, [[rotsworn warrior]]s, [[rotsworn marauder]]s, and [[zombie]]s in the way as you head up towards the fragment, but there will be a [[green dragon]] in front of it. Interact with the curse seal, and you will obtain the [[curse fragment (despair)]].

===Part IV: Imaru's end...===
'''''Item(s) required:''' curse fragment (rage), curse fragment (grief), curse fragment (despair).''

'''''Item(s) recommended:''' food, power level 5 gear, and potions.''

Go into the tower within [[Hope's Fall]] and interact with the seal on Imaru's lair. You will then be prompted to enter her lair by dispelling the curse, and by choosing '''option 1''', you will be able to enter her lair. Upon entering her lair, there will be four [[purifying pool]]s, spots of wither rot, and an atmosphere of death and decay. Imaru will come out of the nearby river in front of you, and you'll be able to fight her. Be warned, as this boss will phase in and out of the soul rift state and attempt to heal herself by devouring souls.

Once she is defeated, you will gain [[Imaru's head]]. Make sure to have one free inventory space to complete the quest. Now you will head back to Death, who will exclaim that Imaru is dead and that you've done well to deal with a potential problem that he didn't want to deal with. Hand him Imaru's head and you will complete the quest.

'''Congratulations! Quest Complete!'''

This will trigger a quest to start talking to the [[Wise Old Man]] at [[Bramblemead Valley]], where he will give you the basics of the [[Farming]] skill. Ensure that at least one inventory space is available to receive the [[wheat seeds]]. 

===Building a plot===
After talking to the Wise Old Man, create an [[ash farming plot]] and dig the plot whilst wielding the [[wooden spade]]. Dig five times, and you will receive at least three [[weeds]] and 3 Farming experience. It is recommended to store the weeds inside a [[compost bin]] to create compost for future plots. After digging the wheat plot, place the wheat seeds in your inventory (or equip the seeds) and left-click on the plot. You will receive 5 Farming experience for planting the wheat seeds. After spreading the seeds, you will need to water the wheat plot at each stage by equipping a full watering can. You can fill your watering can by pressing the {{Key press|F}} key on a pond of water. Water the wheat plot five times until you see a check mark at the bottom of the watering icon. You will need to wait half an in-game day (12 minutes client-side) for the wheat chute to grow into a wheat stalk. 

Once the wheat chute grows into a wheat stalk, water the plot five times again. At any time during the process, not watering the plant after six in-game hours after the next phase will result in the wheat chute becoming diseased. You will not be able to create [[plant cure]], so you will have to start again. 

After waiting another in-game day, the wheat stalk will turn into harvestable wheat. Harvest the wheat before talking to the Wise Old Man again, and he will reward you with a pack of Farming supplies.

==Walkthrough==
===Starting off===
The quest can be started by talking to Doric east of the [[Lake of Lost Souls]], inside a cave ruin near the entrance to the [[Skekven Kara]] vault. He'll inform you that the vault door is sealed by magic and requires you to unlock it. To unlock it, look for four dragonkin statues; activate them to unlock the door.
# One statue is located '''outside the cave entrance''', before entering the cave.
# A statue can be found south-west of Doric, behind the giant pillar. If it is too dark, bring out your torch for better lighting.
# One is located on the top of the pillar, directly west of Doric. You will require the [[Windstep]] spell or build some [[foundation]] and/or [[stairs]].
# The final statue is located north-west of Doric; there will be some rot. Use [[Windstep]] or build some stairs at the location. There will be a cracked wall; you will need a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]] to break it.

===Skekven Kara===
Once you have located and activated all four statues, you can enter the [[Skekven Kara]] [[dragonkin vault|vault]]. Make sure to bring plenty of cooked [[food]] and drinks (such as [[clean water]] or [[infusions]]) as there are multiple enemies within. 

Inside the Skekven Kara vault, proceed in the entry room to the central staircase. At the second highest level of the stairs, an opening in the wall south of the staircase can be reached by using Windstep. In this cavern, interact with the dragonkin statue to learn the secrets, which Doric can translate.

'''Things That Go Boom In The Night''' is a secondary [[quest]] in [[Fellhollow]]. This quest is a partial continuation of the side storyline of preserving the region of Fellhollow due to Imaru's reign by introducing a new spectral enemy to be found within the region and how the environment is reacting to the adventurer's presence.

== Overview ==
{{Quest details
|desc = Gather Spectral Chinchompa skulls so that Vannaka can help the land heal.
|start = Speak to [[Vannaka]] 
|req = * Partial completion of [[Withering Heights]], to gain access to [[Fellhollow]]

|item_req = Ten [[spectral chinchompa skull]]s

==Walkthrough==
To begin this quest, speak to [[Vannaka]], who can be found west of [[Cathan]]'s location in the [[Bleakfields Valley]] region of Fellhollow. Just like The Wild Hunt, he will explain how the spirits in the area continue to be in torment, and task you to hunt for ten [[spectral chinchompa]]s and bring him ten of their skulls. You must attack and/or kill them as quickly as you can, or they will vanish. They are located across Fellhollow, within wooded areas and groves (like the [[nature spirit]]<nowiki/>s).

Best location to find them near Vannaka is;

* South [[Emberwood]]'s druid circle. 
* [[Witchwillow Range]]'s [[willow tree]] grove.

There should be enough for you to kill and collect their skulls. But if you missed one or a few, they take up to 10 in-game days to spawn, so other locations are;

* In another [[Willow Tree|willow tree]] grove north of [[Hope's Fall]].
* West of [[Doric]]'s camp, where the first statue is before entering the cave. 
** Another is further west, near the shore of the [[Lake of Lost Souls]].
* In the south-eastern wood of [[Silverthorn Keep]]
* In another [[Willow Tree|willow tree]] grove in Silverthorn Keep.
* Most eastern part of [[Silverthorn Keep]], where a [[purification pool]] is located when heading into the keep.

Once you have all ten skulls, he will thank you, believing with your help Fellhollow may know peace again.

'''Congratulations! Quest complete!'''

'''Letters for the Dead''' is a secondary [[Quests|quest]] where [[Player Character|Players]] can speak to [[Postie Pete]] to start it.

==Overview==
{{Quest details
|enemies = None
|item_req = None
|qtype = secondary
|req = Partial completion of [[Withering Heights]]

}}

==Map==
{{Map|Postbox|width=250px|height=300px|center=-15530.708,138648.88|zoom=1}}

==Walkthrough==
===Lending a hand...===
Speak to Postie Pete and select '''option 2''' to talk about this quest. He will ask you (while making a bone pun) if you can help him with something. Accepting his question, Postie Pete will mention how, by RPDT standards, he made a big mistake by misplacing some posts. He will tell you that, as he looked in his bag, someone came by and nabbed three letters. This mysterious thief then fled into Fellhollow. He then tells you that, after taking a quick look, he noticed someone shifty near the little house just outside the entrance to Fellhollow. He will then ask you to take a look for him.

===The Missing Postage===
{{Needed|recommended=Lodestone access to Fellhollow; Food, drink, and gear}}

Walk slightly north-east of the entrance to Fellhollow (where you find Ravanna's third journal) and you will find a suspicious skeleton sitting down in a chair. Talk to it and you will find that they are animate in a similar manner to Postie Pete. They mention being bone idle for the moment and hating puns, but asks you what you want. You have the following options:

Click on '''option 3''', the skeleton will reveal that they haven't gotten any letters. This little ''accidental'' reveal will give you more dialogue options.

From this point, the skeleton will continue to gaslight you. They will say that you had already mentioned it before (No, you didn't) and, thus, open up new dialogue options. Choose '''option 1''' in this new dialogue and the gaslighting continues. By choosing '''option 1''' one more time, the skeleton will concede the gaslighting fight and give you one of the letters. Take this letter to a nearby red deposit box northwest of [[Vannaka|Vannaka's]] camp in [[Bleakfields Valley]] and deliver it.

Upon delivering it, a dialogue box will open up to inform you that when you posted the letter, you found a strange leaf that appears to partially fade into the spirit realm. It will then hint to you going into a spectral door.

'''Note:''' ''This will make the Suspicious Skeleton turn into uninteractable scenery once you acquire the letter from them. The relevant postage deposit box will vanish upon closing out of the dialogue box.''

=== The Spectral Postage ===
Head directly east of [[Cathan|Cathan's]] location (at the [[standing stones]]) to a glowing wall torch with a letter mail satchel dangling down. Interact with it to acquire one of the missing letters. This letter will want you to deliver it to the standing stones in Bleakfields Valley. Immediately head towards Cathan's location and, before going up to see him, the red mail deposit box will be on the left side of the trail. Deliver the postage and a dialogue option will appear. It will tell you that you discovered a small patch of ghostly looking fluff and it looks like unspun wool. This will prompt you to look for the former owner.

=== The Wooly Letter ===
Find a ghostly sheep named "Shaun" to retrieve a ghostly letter. He will be almost directly west of where the last postage deposit box was. Upon receiving the letter, you must take the letter to Imaru's Tower. ''As there are plenty of Rotsworn undead here, you will need to be careful.''

Upon arriving at Imaru's Tower, another red postage deposit box will be in front of her tower off to the right. When you deliver the letter you obtained from Shaun, you will then need to return to Postie Pete. When you choose the option to continue the quest, Pete will thank you to delivering the letters and introduce you to the numbskull who caused the problem in the first place. It turns out that said numbskull was, in fact, Postie Pete's sibling and junior RPDT employee [[Parcel Pete]]. While Parcel Pete wanted to help out, it bungled everything up. Postie Pete will inform you that, due to Parcel Pete's "help", he put him on report and filing his PIP. He will then give you a decorative item that, in the future, will enable you to render further aid to him delivering letters.




'''Congratulations! Quest Complete!'''

* Access to an expanding and repeatable activity.

'''What Remains is Written''' is a secondary quest in Fellhollow.

== Overview ==
{{Quest details|desc=Find the stolen knowledge and return it to its owner. I'm sure nothing bad will happen because of it.|item_req=* [[Necromancer's crown]]

== Walkthrough ==

=== Ransacked! ===
Speak to [[Abraxus The Eternal]] in [[Coalridge Pass]] just north of the fork in the road while wearing the full necromancer's gear. He will assume, at least from your clothes, that you are an apprentice of his and will require your aid. He will introduce himself quite arrogantly that you stand in the presence of "Abraxus The Eternal, master of necromancy, Keeper of secrets, both occult and arcane" and inform you that locals have ransacked his library and his most precious tomes have been spread across the eastern sub-regions. He tasks you to find them and bring them back, but not to read any of them. He claims that your mind is too young and too limited to contain the dread secrets within.

=== Hunt For Knowledge Pt. I: Ancient Tomes ===
To find all of the books you need to return to Abraxus, you will need to look through every corner of the Silverthorn Keep region. Here is some books you can find:

* '''[[The Pride of the Avernic]]'''
** Located in the second level of Silverthorn Keep next to a archery target scene.
* '''[[The Importance of Chaos]]'''
** Located just north-west of the ominous gateway. It's lying on a small incline on the south side of a small tower amidst a gateway ruin (which can be seen on the map). It is on the south-western end of the ruin.
* '''[[Aetheric Fundamentals, a Primordial Primer]]'''
** Located across the stone bridge in Silverthorn Keep where you find the curse fragment. There is a green dragon spawn right next to this.
* '''[[The Wrath of Baba Potterington]]'''
** Located in a crumbled stone house near a nature grove north of the 'sil' of Silverthorn Keep on the map.
* '''[[Leonard the Bound]]'''
** Located north-west of the ominous gateway within the ruins that serve as the transition area between the Lake of Lost Souls and Silverthorn Keep areas. The book is on top of the western side of the gate, laying on a pedestal. There will be skeletal hoplites and archers in this area.

Once you have all of the books, return to and speak to Abraxus.

{{Map|Ancient Tomes|width=300px|height=300px|center=-32169.32,214719.23|zoom=2}}

=== Hunt of Knowledge Pt. II: The Secret Scrolls ===
Donning your necromancer's gear, speak to Abraxus. He will be excited to see that you have retrieved his books and hopes you didn't peek at them, but there is more to uncover. He mentions how three of his scrolls were taken from him and how you must reclaim them. He will say that the first scroll was taken from him by Blightscale, a green dragon, and that you must make a lesson of her hubris. The second scroll was taken by Ulgo, a zogre, who can be found nearby. The last one to find was taken by a rival of his called Razlem, the Deranged.

* '''[[Eventide - A New Spawn]]'''
** Defeat [[Razlem, the Deranged]]. He wanders a small ruin directly east of the ominous gateway. You will find the scroll on top of a desk near him.
* '''[[Coclear Malificarum]]'''
** Defeat [[Ulgo the zogre]] in Coalridge Pass. It will be right next to the chest in his hoard. Ulgo is just north of the "Coalridge Pass" label on the map.
* '''[[The Binding of Ib]]'''
** Defeat [[Blightscale]]. Blightscale is a green dragon located at the south side of the cliffs leading up to the Silverthorn Keep, north-east of the ominous gateway. She is immediately past some willow trees and a small set of ruins. There is a spectral door in the small clearing where he's located. The scroll is found near some bones in the clearing.

{{Map|The Secret Scrolls|width=350px|height=350px|center=-34065.10,226460.40|zoom=2}}

Once you have all the scrolls, don your necromancer's gear and speak to [[Abraxus The Eternal|Abraxus]]. He will commend you for your efforts and say that you have earned his respect, which no one has earned for centuries. He will then remark that he isn't foolish enough to believe you can be rewarded only with his respect, as he gives you something that may serve you well. He will then excuse himself to mail a pebble to an old friend of his and hopes that they accept it, so he can haunt them for a while, as he is tired of the view.

'''Congratulations! Quest Complete!'''

== Rewards ==

* 1x [[Abraxus ring]] trinket item and recipe unlock.

==Walkthrough==
{{Map|Mirror Mirror}}

===A Mysterious Mirror...===
To begin this quest, speak to the [[mirror]] west of the Emberwood Village past the green dragon. You will hear crying audio when you first approach them.

They will be surprised to see a real living person in Fellhollow since their imprisonment decades ago and recount how a terrible necromancer sealed them within the mirror. While this necromancer first taunted them with the ritual needed to release them, they claim it is simple to do and shouldn't take long. They will ask you to collect the required items for them to start the ritual.

For the ritual, they need some [[dragon blood]], a copy of their spellbook found within Emberwood Village, and some spectral silver thread.

'''Note:''' You can kill the nearby green dragon or some dragon wolves for the dragon blood.

===Part I: Reagent Collection===
For the copy of their spellbook, go into Emberwood Village (you will need to either have gotten past this point in the Withering Heights quest or reactivated the statues on a new world) and find the destroyed windmill. Inside, you will find a bedraggled spellbook. Pick this up as you will need it.

For the spectral silver thread, you will need to go find [[Edna|Edna's]] skeleton within [[Dragon's Run]]. To find that, look for a crumbling stone house near a willow grove and a rundown gateway. Her skeleton will be sitting back to a corner on the right side. Interact with the skeleton and the spirit of [[Edna]] will inform you that, to make the spectral silver thread, you will need to bring them the following items:

* 1 [[silver bar]]
* 1 fine thread
* 1 [[sacred oil]]
* 6 [[soul fragment]]s

Once you have all these items, bring them back to [[Edna]]. Once you hand over the ingredients, the skeleton will perform a series of gestures which will be too quick for you to follow with your eyes. After a moment, the skeleton will hand you the spectral silver thread and return to rest. Once that is done, head back to the mirror.

===Part II: The Candles===
Speak to the figure in the mirror once again, and they will be happy that you collected all of the reagents. While they will take them off your hands, they mention that you can press them up to the glass, and they will get them. Hand over the reagents, and they will remark about how, while they prepare the ritual on their side, they will need you to tether them back to your reality by rekindling their memories. The reason why is that, due to their age, they have too many memories and need to put some of them safely away. They left a few of their memories as memorial candles within each region they have visited and, for each candle lit, a memory will return to help anchor them into reality. The figure will give you a small piece of their soul to help ignite these memorial candles and, once each candle is lit, they will be to return.

This is where you will need to visit each region of Ashenfall to light the candles. On your map, the candle areas will be highlighted blue. Here is the list of each candle location within the regions:

* '''Fellhollow:''' Right next to the mirror.
* '''Ghornfell:'''
** '''Fractured Plains:''' Next to a small lake south-south-east of Velgar's Rise. The lake will contain floating rune essence.
** '''Stormtouched Highlands:''' A bit north-east of the garou castle at the edge of a cliff. It will be along the edge of the territory.
** '''Bloodblight Swamp:''' West of the garou encampment leading towards the bloodwood tree.
* '''Brynmoor:'''
** '''Whispering Swamp:''' Next to a giant swamp tree on the third most western island from the vault.
** '''Bramblemead Valley:''' South of the [[Crasorak Kara]] vault, atop the cliff and behind the rocks.

With the final memory candle lit, head back to the mirror.

===Part III: A Week-long Ride===
Speak to the figure in the mirror, and it will inform you that it will get started on the ritual, but their freedom will take roughly a week or so. While you could wait to see what happens, they inform you that you don't need to stick around that long. You have done everything needed to help free them from their reflective prison and give you a reward for your assistance.

'''Congratulations! Quest Complete!'''

Enter Dowdun Reach... | series = Kuldra's Saga }}'''Black Knight's Fortress''' is the seventh primary [[Quests|quest]] and the third in the main storyline of ''RuneScape: Dragonwilds''. In this quest, the [[Player Character|Player]] must delve into an ancient mountainous fortress after defeating the revenant dragon [[Imaru]] in order to gain access to the [[Umbral Sands]]. == Quest Overview == {{Quest details|desc=Uncover the secrets of Dowdun Reach in order to unlock your way through to the Umbral Sands.|enemies=* Multiple [[Black Knights]] * Multiple [[mage of Zamorak]] * Multiple [[hellhound]]s * Four (different location) [[shardbound lesser demon]]s * [[Lesser demon]] * [[Blue dragon]] * [[Black Knight Titan]]|item_req=* Steel or Undead Spade * Steel or Mithril Pickaxe * Mithril Logging Axe * Fishing Rod (Any, preferably highest available)|qtype=primary|rec=* Good [[food]], potions * Good armour|req=* [[Withering Heights]] * Level 41 [[Cooking]] to cook [[maple sap]] into [[maple syrup]], or a [[maple toastie]] from a food [[salvage]] spot (1/24)|start=Speak to Death in the Forgotten Temple.}} == Walkthrough == === Part I: The Dark Fortress... === {{Map|Ominous Door|height=250px|width=250px|center=-351.45294,210897.64|float=right}} Speak to [[Death (Grim Reaper)|Death]] in the Forgotten Temple. He will mention about how you did well in Fellhollow, but that there is more for you to do. A colleague of his is waiting for you in the [[Umbral Sands]] to help him, but instructs you to speak to Cathan to gather allies and investigate. You can find Cathan east of Fellhollow, near the ominous gatehouse in the south of [[Silverthorn Keep]]. Speak to Cathan, who greets you, and he will comment about how the adventure never ends. He will then right to it and explain how he has been investigating the ominous gatehouse and, while it leads to some fortress, it is blocking the way to the Umbral Sands. He tells you how he wanted to scout out the place more all spooky-like, but made the mistake of mentioning it to the [[Wise Old Man]]. Knowing how he is like, Cathan mentioned about how he murmured some stuff like "amateur hour wards" and "rubbish defences" before storming down the passageway. Cathan will inform you that, if you want to go after him, to look for him in some sort of central point (like a nexus or something). Go through the open gateway and enter through the '''ominous door''' (Image right). '''Note:''' ''This will play a small intro cutscene to the area''. You will then arrive within [[The Approach]]. Traverse southward through this new region until you enter [[The Courtyard]] where you will meet the Wise Old Man. === Part II: Shadows Within === Speak to the Wise Old Man, who will mention about how you had an easier time getting here than they did and walloping a few troublesome people. He'd then mention about how he was hoping to hunt down another dragon to whittle down Kuldra's forces, but complains about the fortress full of Zamorakians in the way. Despite the bothersome trouble in the way, he mentions how great it is that you're here to help get them moving again. Troubling thing is, he mentions how the way is blocked by someone called "the gatekeeper" and he isn't sure who or what it may be. Despite not being aware of who or what it is, the Wise Old Man tells you that [[Doric]] is currently working on dispelling a nasty magical barrier further ahead in the Nexus. He then says how it might be a good idea to make a base camp here first. After making a base camp, follow the path leading up into the fortress. Arrive at [[The Nexus]] and speak to Doric. Once you speak to him, he will mention about how crazed the Black Knights are along with how they look like they should have all died long ago. He mentions how the problem is that you are all stuck here and he has everything to get the door open. As far as Doric can tell, everything seems to be connected to a [[Avisk|great big stone]] next to him. He says that it looks broken and, theorising a way to get past the door, might need to fix it using some missing pieces. Inspect the stone. This will reveal a small dialogue from the stone itself describing how it is broken, shards of itself are missing, and that you should find the missing pieces to repair it. ===Getting Started===
Speak to [[Vannaka]], who can be found by the tent in front of [[The Library]] shortly after entering [[Dowdun Reach]]. He explains that three Black Knights — the [[Rat Master Skrexis|Rat Master]], the [[Houndmaster Rexiton|Hound Master]], and the [[Summoner Flament|Summoner]] — have each gained control over different demonic creatures, and asks you to retrieve their training journals.

Vannaka can provide background on each of the three beast tamers if you ask. The three targets can be tackled in any order. Each is a genuine combat encounter with multiple enemies, so come prepared.

===The Rat Master===
Head south-west from Vannaka to [[The Menagerie]]; you'll need to cross The Library and defeat the [[lesser blue dragon]] guarding the entrance to The Menagerie before making your way further. [[Rat Master Skrexis]] can be found on a ledge at the end of the lower path, surrounded by his [[hellrat]]s. He was once a reclusive knight with terrible hygiene habits who attracted vermin wherever he went — the corruption has only deepened that bond.

Defeat him and his pack of hellrats. Once the area is clear, look for his journal sitting on a rock directly behind where he was standing, to the left of the statue. Interact with it to read or take some pages.

Make your way to [[The Garrison]] and descend to the lower floors of the forward building. [[Houndmaster Rexiton|Philius Rexiton]], the Hound Master, was a noble with a love for dogs before the corruption took hold. Now he commands a whole pack of [[hellhound]]s in the dungeons below.

This is a crowded fight — you'll be dealing with Rexiton and his entire pack at once. Try to manage the hellhounds while keeping pressure on the Hound Master himself. After defeating them, the journal is in the central kennel, lying on the table.

[[Summoner Flament|Lester Flament]], the Summoner, wanders here with [[Delrom]], his eerily loyal [[Lesser Demon|demon]]. Flament was reputedly odious and unpopular even among the Black Knights.

Delrom hits hard, so don't underestimate this fight. Once the Summoner is defeated, pick up his journal from the plinth at the back wall, below the demon gargoyle.

===Returning to Vannaka===
With all three journals in hand, return to [[Vannaka]]. He eagerly examines the journals, expecting to find dark rites and sinister spells — only to discover that the beast tamers' secret was treating the creatures kindly.

==Walkthrough==
{{Map|What's Theirs is Mine!|center=49918.92,228791.79|zoom=1.8|float=right}}

===Getting Started===
Speak to [[Doric]] in [[The Nexus]]. He explains that a red-robed wizard barged into him and stole a small bronze dog on a keychain — a keepsake made by his son, Boric, and one of his most treasured possessions. The mage fled through one of the nearby portals, and Doric caught a brief glimpse of pews and religious fixtures before the thief vanished.

Doric asks you to chase the mage through the portals and recover his keepsake. He points out that following the trail should also help you activate the [[nodestone]]s scattered around [[Dowdun Reach]], opening up fast-travel routes through the keep.

The three locations can be visited in any order. Each is in hostile territory, so come prepared.

===The Cathedral===
Make your way to [[The Cathedral]] region in Dowdun Keep. The [[nodestone]] here sits on the north-west wing of the building and can't be reached from inside — enter the cathedral and turn right, then follow the outer walkway around the side. Look for a section where the parapets are missing and use [[Windstep]] to reach the upper ledge where the nodestone and notes are located.

The scrawled notes on a nearby table are incoherent ramblings about the nature of portal magic — the mage was studying how the nodestones in the keep work without [[Law Rune|runes]], drawing power from the [[Shard of the Dreaming Stone|Dreaming Stone]] instead.

There's no sign of the mage himself, but the nearby nodestone crackles with lingering energy. Activate it and return to Doric.

Back at The Nexus, Doric reports that you just missed the mage — the red-robed wizard ran right past him again, waving a great spiky staff around "without fear of poking anyone's eyes out." This time the portal showed chains, cells, and angry-looking knights. A garrison, perhaps.

===The Garrison===
Head to [[The Garrison]] and make your way to the building with four turrets on the norther face of the fortress. Inside, look for the mage's schematics sitting atop a crate near the [[nodestone]], on the first floor. These notes describe some form of emotion-based magic — an attempt to draw energy from suffering and channel it into a source of great pain.

Again, no mage in sight. Activate the nodestone and return to Doric.

Doric tells you the mage sprinted past him once more, and this time the portal showed glowing lights, water, and rock — some sort of sinister demonic gateway.

===The Demon Gate===
Travel to [[The Demon Gate]], the underground area beneath Dowdun Keep. This is the one location where you'll face a proper fight: make your way through the area to the far end, past two [[shardbound lesser demon]]s guarding an arena.

On the other side, you'll find the body of the [[Zamorak]] mage. The wounds are fresh — singed robes and claw marks raked across his torso. Whatever he was trying to accomplish with his portal magic and emotion-draining schematics, the demons got to him first.

Search the body. There's no sign of Doric's keepsake, but you do find a crumpled schematic of some kind. Take it and return to Doric.

===Returning to Doric===
Speak to [[Doric]] back in [[The Nexus]]. In a moment of sheepish honesty, he admits the mage never actually stole the bronze dog at all — when the wizard knocked into him, the keepsake fell out of his pocket and rolled behind a rock. The whole chase was a wild goose chase.

Feeling guilty, Doric examines the schematic you recovered from the dead mage. He identifies it as a design for some sort of sinister staff and, by way of apology, teaches you how to craft it — the [[Zamorak staff]].

He also mentions that the nodestones seem like they'd be quite useful to have fully operational, and suggests you activate the rest of them around [[Dowdun Reach]] for an additional reward.

===Bonus: Activating All Nodestones===
If you activate all nine [[nodestone]]s throughout Dowdun Reach and return to Doric, he'll congratulate you — then grumble about adventurers always expecting a reward. He hands over a '''portal reward pack''' containing tier 2 [[Artisan]], [[Construction]], [[Magic]], and [[Mining]] experience tomes.

==Walkthrough==
To start this quest, create a [[coarse net]] at the crafting table. This will trigger the quest for you to speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Valley. Speak to him and choose option 2. This will make him remark about how you made yourself a very useful tool (remarking about the net) and remember in his very distant youth about spending countless hours catching something in a local pond with a net and how the owners weren't happy. He then says about how you can find yourself a nice spot to relax and wile away the dull hours of daylight between adventures and to challenge yourself to finding that single pristine fish. He continues about how he hadn't eaten a good fish in ages and asks you to catch him a sardine in the Brynmoor waters, but tells you that you'd need to use a fishing rod to catch one and craft bait to aid you.

'''Note:''' This will start the next objective, which is to capture a raw sardine.

He then begins to tell you that you can boil, roast, stew, and make a lot of delicious meals out of them. He also says that if you find really nice ones, you can put them on display. After this, you will be presented with four options to discuss fishing.

===Gone Fishin!===
'''Item(s) required:''' ''Any fishing net, Ash Rod.''

In order to get to the sardines, you will need to get some Fishing levels.

Head to any nearby [[net fishing spot]] and stand within it while wielding your net to start trawling to capture [[raw shrimp]], and you'll unlock [[shrimp bait]]. Keep capturing shrimp using your net until you reach level 3, where you'll unlock the ability to create [[Fishing#Fishing Rods|Fishing Rods]]. Go to your crafting table and use 1 [[Ash Logs|ash log]] and 1 [[coarse thread]] to make an [[ash rod]], then with the shrimp you've caught, create some shrimp bait (each shrimp gives 1 bait).

Once you have your fishing rod and bait, head to a nearby [[rod fishing spot]] and fish there.

Unlike with net fishing, you will need to equip ''both'' your fishing rod and bait to start rod fishing. Hold down your cast button (LMB by default) and release it to start fishing, but it is possible to miss the spot if you cast too weakly or too strongly. Once you've successfully cast into the fishing spot, you will need to use your strafe left/right buttons (A and D buttons respectively) to tire out the fish. A bar will appear above the bottom-middle of your screen that will gradually disappear. If the bar remains '''blue''', you will begin to tire out the fish, but if it is '''red''', that means the fish is stronger and reeling in the fish will consume greater amounts of stamina. When the fish is tired out, an option will appear to reel in the fish.

When the bar is empty, you will have caught a fish. This can either be a sardine or a trout.

'''Note:''' ''Fishing will consume your stamina rapidly. If you do not reel in your fish quickly before depleting your stamina, your fish will escape.''

Once you have caught your sardine, head back to the Wise Old Man.

===Back to the grind!===
Bringing the sardine you've caught back to him, the Wise Old Man will remark how you've caught a wonderful delicious sardine and how it brings back old memories. Before cooking the sardine like how his grampa used to, he rewards you for a job well done.

'''Congratulations! Quest complete!'''

== Walkthrough ==
=== Part I: Starting off ===
'''Note:''' ''Interacting with the door to the Umbral Sands will play a small introduction cutscene to the region.''

After defeating the Black Knight Titan and talking to Avisk, head back to [[The Bastion]] and interact with the door to the Umbral Sands. ''It is highly recommended that you do this during the night cycle at full rest.'' Once you have interacted with the door, you will arrive at the [[Alcarrid Oasis]] sub-region. Speak to [[Shangruuh - Alcarrid Envoy|Shangruuh]] right as you arrive to start the quest. 

Arriving to the camp, speak to [[Ancamairon - Alcarrid Elder|Ancamairon]], who will next to [[Icthlarin]]. Icthlarin requests one of the [[mirror lens]] they hold in order to use the [[mirrors]] and break the seal that blocks [[Fuzan]]'s [[Fight Cave|tower]]. The garou does not trust an outsider, let alone a demigod, with their sacred item. So you will be asked to gain the trust of the Moon Garou, starting with the Alcarrid camp.

Once you accept the quest, you'll need to speak to certain NPCs to progress.

Speak to any of them to start the tasks needed to convince the elder of the Alcarrid tribe.

==== Rogue Trader ====
''Item(s) required'': [[Mithril pickaxe]] (or better)'','' inventory space.{{Map|Moonstone|height=250px|width=250px|zoom=2|center=132464.7,213276.7|float=right}}

Speak to [[Domri - The Merchant|Domri]] who will request that you locate three [[moonstone]]<nowiki/>s that are likely hidden in the western area of the desert under some [[gypsum node]]s within rocky areas or caves. The map and compass will direct you to the locations. Be sure to check each nodes to find the moonstone.{{Sic|The stones are in the same location for each players, we're trying to work on a map.}} Once you visit all three locations, return to Domri, who will be shocked that the moonstones are real and will reward you with his trust and access to his shop.

==== The Mirror Crack'd ====
''Item(s) required'': 3 [[adamant bar]]. If mining the materials: a [[mithril pickaxe]] (or better), 9 [[adamantite ore]] and 9 [[coal]].

Speak to [[Valas - The Blacksmith|Valas]], and they will remark about how your task to repair the mirrors smells like folly to them. They commend your spirit, but then tell you how the mirrors are sacred to them because of the [[Elidinis|River Goddess]] placing them there to remind them of who must protect Umbral Sands.

Speak to Valas again when you have the bars. Click on option 1 to hand over the bars, and they will say that they will fix the mirrors for you when you collect all of the lenses. They will inform the elder of your part in getting that job done and give you a nice farewell. They will also give you 200 [[garou chit]] for your troubles.

==== Rag and Bone Garou ====
''Item(s) required'': 3 [[raw farm meat]], 3 [[kalphite shell fragments]], and 3 [[cactus steak]]s

Speak to [[Lagra - The Butcher|Lagra]], who wants you to help them with a task and clarifies that they are a butch (or butcher) and want you to bring them three of the following: [[Raw farm meat]], [[kalphite shell fragments]], and [[cactus steak]]s. You can collect the raw farm meat from nearby vultures, goats, or from your own chests if you have any. The shell fragments can also be found by killing kalphites in the desert or if you have some already. As for cactus steaks, you only need to chop down one or two bunny cactuses with an adamant (or better) logging axe or collect them from your chests.

Speak to Lagra again when you have the items. Choose option 1 to hand over the meats, and they will praise your work by saying that you have an eye for dead tissue and exoskeletons. They will give you their trust and give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.

Once you have completed the three tasks above, return to Ancamairon. He will mention that the Alcarrid clan now trusts you and that the butcher has even made a dish after you. 

'''Reward:''' ''[[Moon Garou pack]] and a new Magic Carpet [[mount]].'' 

After completing the tasks for the Alcarrid clan, you now have to navigate to other areas of the desert to collect their lenses. You can go to either the Manafem clan in the southern area of the desert (within the [[Manafem Plains]]) or the Uzzer clan in the east (within the [[Dunes of Uzzer]]) and speak to their respective elders to discuss building reputation and claiming the lenses.

=== Part II: Manafem Trouble ===
Speak to [[Dúshlánach - Manafem Elder|Dúshlánach]] in the [[Manafem Plains|Manafem]] camp. They will mention that you are a bad omen at a bad time, calling you Unmarked, and reveal they bear the Mark of Fuzan and how that mark is a wound that carves deep. From this Mark, they are slowly losing their will to fight and their sanity, but they do say that their pride is not being lost. They say that while the clan needs help, they are reluctant to accept it. This means that their tasks will be somewhat harder. Just like with the Alcarrid clan, there are three tasks that must be done to acquire their lens.

'''Note:''' ''[[Beartach - The Merchant|Beartach]] will not offer any quests, but completing the reputation quests will increase his reputation by one level.''

==== Song of the Ancients ====
''Item(s) required:'' Good [[weapons]], [[armour]], [[food]] and 5 [[air rune]]<nowiki/>s

Speak to [[Laguna - The Bard|Laguna]], who is sitting next to a net fishing spot. They would like you to venture into [[Dragonkin Vault|the Vault]] located south of the camp and write down the lyrics of the songs as they do not like beetles and heard that beetles reside within the vault.

The vault they spoke of will be circled in green on your map. Be warned that this is a [[kalphite]] nesting area, so you will need to rush to the entrance to avoid being outnumbered by kalphites and [[KotHaar]] that lurk around the area.

Enter the vault door and head towards the next platform. You will need to summon a [[scarab staff]] and take it with you, as this will prevent the scarabs within the dungeon from hurting you. After summoning the staff, the first ancient garou statue will be to the right. Collect this before continuing deeper into the vault. 

You will be in combat sometime, and the staff can be swapped for you to protect yourself, which will allow you to pick the staff back up. In the first room, follow the path that leads to a lever, pull it but to not proceed as east of the lever there is a [[Ancient Garou Statue|ancient garou statue]] for you to transcribe. Follow the path and head into the next room, where the statue will be located on top of a platform, requiring [[Windstep]] to reach. Now that you have acquired all of the lyrics, you ''may'' return to Laguna in the Manafem camp.

'''Note''': ''The next two levers will open the way to one of the [[Kalphite Queen]]<nowiki/>s. If you are prepared, you can enter the encounter to claim extra reward on beating her, such as the [[keris]]' [[vestige]], [[corroded curved blade]].''

Speak to Laguna again and they will be happy that you found them all and wants to weave them into a song. After that, they promise to vouch for you with the Manafem Elder.

==== Scaling Difficulties ====
''Item(s) required'': Good [[weapons]], [[armour]], and [[food]].{{Map|entity=|width=250px|height=250px|center=206772,260417|zoom=3|Scaling Difficulties|float=right}}Speak to [[Hedric - The Hunter|Hedric]], he'll tasks you with looking for his lost scouting party. The scouting party were tracking a creature that had been picking off his people one by one and asks you to look for them towards the east and kill the beast.

After talking with [[Hedric - The Hunter|Hedric]], head towards the green area on your map east from the Manafem camp. Within that area, there will be three clues in the area, two dead garou scouts and a scorched mark. You'll learn that the scouting party is dead, and Neither the [[Scorch]], the sandstorms or Fuzan could have made them, but something else. Head further east to where the green circle is on your map and you will find a [[red dragon]]. Kill it and gain [[the radiant heart]]. 

Head back to [[Hedric - The Hunter|Hedric]] and speak with him and you will recount how you found their bodies and slain the red dragon nearby. He will thank you for finding their bodies and, that now you made it safe, will send someone to go collect their bodies. He will remark that the dragon you slain is small-fry compared to Fuzan, hopes you know what your doing, and recommended you to their Elder. He will give you 200 garou chit for your troubles. 

==== Beast in the Sand ====
Item(s) required: 1 [[clean water]].

Speak to [[Manathep - The Bereaved|Manathep]] and she will tell you about how the [[Dearg Due]] killed her poor [[Efina - The Lost|Efina]]. She mentions that Efina was taken three days ago and every night, the Dearg Due watches her from the south of their camp with a glint in her eye and blood on her lips. She asks you to kill the Dearg Due south of the camp and bring back Efina's body.

Head west of the pyramid vault and track down the Dearg Due in the sandstorm. Follow it until you meet Efina. Speak to her and she will ask for clean water. Give her some clean water and she will say that her strength is coming back to her while thanking you. she then reveals that she ran away from the Manafem camp due to the Mark of Fuzan draining everyone. She then asks you to tell her mum that she is safe and on her way back. The Dearg Due howls back, but you get the sense that a curse has been lifted and the Dearg Due is free to move on from this world.

Return to speak to Manathep. She will praise the River Goddess in joy that her daughter is safe and thinks that the Dearg Due lured her out of the camp as a trick and says the Efina wouldn't go out there alone. She will then give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.

Once you have completed these tasks, speak again to Dúshlánach.

'''Reward:''' ''Level 4 reputation with [[Beartach - The Merchant]]'s shop, 1 [[mirror lens]], and a [[Moon Garou pack]].''

=== Part III: Heart of Uzzer ===
Speak to [[Gaimbín - Uzzer Elder|Gaimbín]] within the [[Dunes of Uzzer]], who will doubt your skills and warns you to leave as they needed to prepare for the event of Fuzan's Marking. Of course you'll be once again tasked to gain the clan's trust in order for the elder to reward you with the mirror lens.

==== The Dig Site ====
{{Map|Forbidden Scroll - 'Sun Demon',Forbidden Scroll - 'The Schism',Forbidden Scroll - 'Moon Goddess',Forbidden Scroll - 'Old Kingdom'|height=250px|width=250px|zoom=3|center=178805.900521,370596.933689|float=right}}
''Item(s) required'': 1 [[spade]] of any kind, good [[weapons]], [[armour]] and [[food]] to defend yourself from the [[KotHaar]].

Speak to [[Lehran - The Archaeologist|Lehran]], who asks that you help him learn the truth of his ancestors, and he will vouch for you with the elder. He tells you that there are some ruins to the far south, long lost to the sands, and that the KotHaar have prevented him from travelling there himself. He reveals that the Forbidden Scrolls are meant to tell the truth about what happened to the Moon Garou centuries ago and not the stuff fed to them by their Elders. He asks you to go dig them up and bring back the scrolls to him, offering to also share the revelations with you if there are any.

Head to the area marked on your map, with your spade in your inventory/hotbar. To find the scrolls, you will need to locate areas that are similar to buried chests. Each Forbidden Scroll will be in one specific ruin, with two of them hidden behind locked gates. As there will be KotHaar and goats in the area, you will have to fight them in order to dig peacefully. There are four scrolls you will need to find, and they are the following:

* [[Forbidden Scroll - 'The Schism'|'The Schism']]
* [[Forbidden Scroll - 'Sun Demon'|'Sun Demon']]
* [[Forbidden Scroll - 'Old Kingdom'|'Old Kingdom']]
* [[Forbidden Scroll - 'Moon Goddess'|'Moon Goddess']]

Once you have all four scrolls, return to Lehran. Give him the scrolls, and he will then give you 200 garou chit and the [[Saga (Icthlarin's Little Helper)|saga]] for your troubles.

==== Saga of the Adventurer ====
{{Map|Saga of the Adventurer|height=250px|width=250px|zoom=1|center=59009.2,351799.1|float=right}}
{{Needed|1 [[torch]], good [[weapons]], [[armour]] and [[food]] to better defend yourself against wandering enemies.}}

Speak to [[Laguna - The Bard|Laguna]], and they will tell you that they are on the market for a business partner and one with survival skills. They will tell you that there are four rocky spires around the pyramid close to this camp and that each spire holds a statue. They will ask you to go find each statue and note down the inscribed passages. Each passage, woven together, will form a saga. They will give you a [[Saga (Icthlarin's Little Helper)|book]] and remind you to note down the passages at the rocky spires.

Head towards the area marked on your map. You will find towering rocky spires around the Pyramid, and you must interact with them. Some of these statues are hidden in caves blocked by sandstone nodes, and others are protected by either KotHaar or kalphites. Inspect each statue to gain a piece of the saga. Once you have collected enough pieces of the saga, you will then need to follow a direction pointing towards a specific direction. Head to the spire with the [[Nightmare Crucible|Nightmare Crucible of Humilitation]] entrance, and the last ancient garou statue contains the full saga.

Once you have the complete saga, return to Laguna. They will congratulate you on finishing the saga and would enjoy performing at Fuzan's Mark Day, but for now, they will sing praises of your deeds to the elder. They also remark that you are free to unlock and explore the gateways as you see fit.

'''Note:''' ''You will gain a Crucible Engram of Humiliation for completing this segment.''

==== Mark Day ====
{{Map|Mark Day|height=500px|width=500px|zoom=2|center=133277.7,338023.1|float=right}}

=== Part IV: Fuzan Trials ===
''Item(s) required'': Good [[weapons]], [[armour]], and [[food]].

''Visit [[Fuzan/Strategies]] for a guide to fighting Fuzan.''

Speak to Icthlarin and he will say that there is little time to waste and that we must repair the mirrors. He informs you that he has positioned them carefully and believes they are directed at Fuzan's Lens, which is a dragonkin relic that protects both his volcano and powers his Mark. That belief, he says, will be tested now and prays to Elidnis for help if he's wrong. == Walkthrough ==
=== Getting Started ===
Speak to Zi in Umbral Sands to start this quest. KotHaar-Zi is located in The Burning Spire, directly south-east of Sinking Pyramid on an 'L-shaped' island.
===Protection from Scorch===
KotHaar-Zi will inform you that their body was not made to survive Scorch and asks for assistance with adapting. They ask you to bring them 3 [[raw beltfish]] and 1 [[cactus steak]].

==="THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE!"===
After returning to KotHaar-Zi, they will tell you about four pedestals, scattered around the Burning Spire area - giant black blocks with fire on top. They ask you to touch all four of them in any order and then return to KotHarr-Zi. A blue circle will be added to your map, showing the area the four pedestals are located at. 

* Pillar 1: Located east of the Sunken Pyramid, on top of a large rock structure.
* Pillar 2: Located north of the Sunken Pyramid, behind KotHaar-Zi. 
* Pillar 3: Located west of the Sunken Pyramid.
* Pillar 4: Located south of the Sunken Pyramid, south-west from KotHaar-Zi. 

After interacting with all four pillars, return to KotHaar-Zi.

===Cave of Screams===

After talking to KotHaar-Zi, they will tell you they are heading to the [[Cave of Screams]], which is located west of the Sunken Pyramid. At the entrance to the Cave of Screams, there will be a bouncer who will ask for a password.

Make your way to the Cave of Screams entrance, located in the top-left corner of The Burning Spire, directly right of the tree icon found on the map.

Talk to the [[KotHaar Bouncer]]. Pick any of the three dialogue options - it doesn't matter which you choose. After picking the third dialogue option, you will be given a [[KotHaar numbering for dummies]] scroll. Inspect the scroll in your quest inventory. 

Talk to the Bouncer again and select the option which says "Two triangles separated by a line?".

You will now be able to access the Cave of Screams. The bouncer will warn you that KotHaar-Zi has changed, and that their core must be forged into a new body, a new body which is controlled by [[Fuzan]].

===Reforged Zi===
Upon entering the Cave of Screams, you'll immediately be met by two hostile [[KotHaar-Xil]] and a hostile [[KotHaar-Hok-Zi|Reforged Zi]]. Defeat all three enemies. After Reforged Zi is defeated, [[Zi core]] will appear on the ground - grab it and then exit the cave.

===Return to the Bouncer===

Talk to the Bouncer. They will award you for assisting with Zi and reward you with the [[plate of pure obsidian]], which unlocks recipe for [[obsidian cape]].

''Quest Completed!''

==Walkthrough==
[[File:Doctor Fenkenstrain (Head).png|thumb|width=182x182|Start the quest by speaking to Doctor Fenkenstrain.]]
To start this quest, speak to Doctor Fenkenstrain in the [[Bloodblight Swamp]]. He will be in his tower next to the garou camp around the bloodwood tree and on the same floor as the sanguine urn.

When you start talking to him, he will remark that they called him mad and that he'll show them. After a minute, he'll finally notice you and ask who you are. Choosing any option will result in him not caring who you are and asking you if you can help him out with something. He wants you to go collect some arms, legs, and that sort of stuff from graves all around the swamp. This will lead you to collect three items: Arms, Legs, Torso.

Locate graves by their headstones in the Bloodblight Swamp and use your spade/shovel near them to dig up a coffin. Interact with the coffin to collect the parts.

* [[Human Torso]]: Near the abyssal demon. In the centre of three trees.
* [[Goblin Legs]]: North of the torso coffin. Between two trees.
* [[Garou Arms]]: Near the northern entrance to the Bloodblight Swamp.

Once you have all of the items, return to the doctor. Speak to him, and he will make a dumb pun about your unusual collection of body parts before asking you to place the parts on the examination table. Interact with the nearby examination table and speak to the doctor once more. He will ask you to examine the parts, and he will then ask you to bring him one weak antipoison potion, one weak Focused Attack potion, and one weak Lumberjack potion. Collect the potions and return to the doctor.

Use the potions (after speaking to the doctor again), and he will say that the body needs lightning, giving you an empty vial. You will need to get struck by lightning to fill the vial.

You can either wait for a thunderstorm event in nearly any of the regions, or head to the Stormtouched Highlands and wait to get struck by lightning. Once you have the [[Lightning-in-a-bottle]], head back to the doctor.

Speak to him again, and he will ask you to put his head on the incomplete body on the examination table. Interact with the body to place the doctor's head on it, and then use the lighting-in-a-bottle on the nearby pylon. Once you interact with the nearby pylon, the doctor's head on the body will swap with the nearby chicken's head.

Speak to the doctor on the chicken's body to learn that he miscalculated. He will then give you your reward to distract you while he works out his tricky situation.

'''Congratulations! Quest complete!'''

== Walkthrough ==

=== Part I: The Gate Opens ===
To start this quest, players must have completed [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]]. After that, head back into the Fractured Plains and head north-west of Velgar's Rise. You will soon come across a Dragon Gate that will take you into the Scorned Wilderness. Interact with the gate and it will tell you that the blood of the four seal the gate. It will then tell you that the lord of the skies has fallen, [[Xikotal]] slain by [[Kuldra]], Velgar's cruelty no longer infects the earth, Imaru finally rests in peace, and Fuzan's flames have been extinguished. Choose the option to journey into the Scorned Wilderness.

'''Note:''' ''This will play the narrative trailer for the [[Scorned Wilderness]].''

Once you pass through the gate, the journey begins. Speak to [[Commander Zilyana|Zilyana]] in [[Scorned Wilderness#Rasthin's Rest|Rasthin's Rest]]. She explains that she was sent there by [[Saradomin]] to deal with the threat, but requires your aid, as getting closer to Kuldra's lair weakens her. Zilyiana mentions that the location you are in makes a perfect base, it is advised that you build a new base here so that you can return after using a checkpoint, rest, craft and so on. After you have set up a base here, speak to Zilyana to continue to the first location.

Speak to Zilyana, and start the raid, you will be transported to [[Scorned Wilderness#Dragontail Vines|Dragontail Vines]]. 

'''Note:''' ''For a strategy guide, see [[Scorned Wilderness]]. You'll need to clear the raid in order to complete the quest.''

=== Part II: Death of a Queen ===
After defeating Kuldra, Zilyana will transport you back to Rasthin's Rest, where she will inform you that due to the veil, their deeds will go unnoticed for now. You are rewarded for your help.

'''''Congratulations! Quest Complete!'''''
